description: Congestion levels for the live heatmap, replay and prediction classes. A junction's level is the WORSE of its occupancy level and its queue-per-lane level, both measured on the junction's incoming vehicle lanes (TraCI lane occupancy and halting-vehicle counts, speed < 0.1 m/s). Thresholds are project conventions for visualisation, not a standard level-of-service definition.

road_state.description: Six road levels for the Command Center. Display conventions, not a level-of-service standard. Capacity is estimated as lane metres / vehicle_spacing_m.
